sources.title: Embassy of Grenada: Who Needs A Visa
sources.publisher: Embassy of Grenada in the People's Republic of China, Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry of Foreign Affairs mission page still links the dated nationality schedule but gives no current-force or replacement statement.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Updated List of Countries Needing a Visa to visit Grenada

sources.title: Visa Requirements for Traveling to Grenada
sources.publisher: Embassy of Grenada in the People's Republic of China, Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The document is currently hosted and linked by the Ministry's mission page, but identifies itself as updated February 2021 and has no 2026 confirmation.

sources.title: Embassy of Grenada: visa requirements for Chinese passport holders
sources.publisher: Embassy of Grenada in the People's Republic of China, Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The live MFA mission guidance gives a current China-specific visitor rule, but does not confirm the rest of the February 2021 schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Chinese passport holders do not need a visa for visits to Grenada not exceeding 30 days.

sources.title: Government of Grenada: Immigration forms
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Government Immigration page provides a visa application form but no nationality schedule or confirmation of the 2021 table.
